name: dsh-reconnect
description: Safe model-request retry for DeepSeek Harness. Local adaptation of MistRain-1/dsh-reconnect 2.0.0 for dsh 0.2.0-rc.2: versioned patch dialect, no settings-service import (published dsh-settings has no such API), and no client half (no dsh-client-web-react module in the 0.2.x browser shell). Retry behavior keeps upstream v2 semantics.
